status: declared at freeze; the closing LINEAGE_FINAL.json reports what actually happened

canonical_serial_lineage.rule: ONE serial cell; parallel search never adopts; at most one adoption per generation cycle through the full M11 path (vendored #149 EvolutionCell over the real ocm package)

entering_state.mapping_status: MORPHOLOGY_LEVEL_MAP: the parent's route vocabulary mapped into the grammar; not a byte-level re-execution of the parent adapter (both statements recorded in every GenerationSnapshotV1)

canonical_serial_lineage.transition_rule: g_{k+1} exists iff a PDEV cycle terminates DEVELOPMENT_CHANGE_ADOPTED
canonical_serial_lineage.rollback: exact M11 rollback proven in a clone (rollback counterfactual receipt) before/with every adoption
canonical_serial_lineage.cold_restart: identity (generation, config digest, protocol hash) verified by destroying and reopening the cell every cycle
canonical_serial_lineage.disjoint_fresh_use: every generation allocates fresh suites from the parent-disjoint pool; the cell enforces semantic-id disjointness across its own cycles

controls.PARENT: the g2 morphology, fixed forever, re-measured on every generation's suite (matched parent arm)
controls.CONTINUED: serial self-change control continuing from g2 (frozen scalar rule, one adoption per generation max)
controls.RESET: serial self-change control reset to the donor initial morphology (discovering/learned), same procedure, same information surface
controls.discriminator: PDEV-11: does CONTINUED self-change from an already-sufficient g2 still find admissible improvement, versus RESET re-search, versus the parallel population programme

population_note: the QD archive and the 16-arm population are selection organs; they never install configurations; population adoption would break the serial invariant and is not implemented (recorded as a design collision, PROTOCOL.json)
